title: Grafström, FIFA's second-in-command, struggles to break free from Infantino
subhead: The secretary general of FIFA has expressed his support for the controversial president of world football's governing body. title: 'Changing your breasts is changing your life': How breast surgery can profoundly transform women
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (2/5). What if breast surgery changed both self-image and self-perception? Whether rebuilding after cancer or for aesthetic reasons, women never come out of it quite the same. Le Monde spent several weeks behind closed doors in a private breast surgery practice in Paris.

title: 'Why shouldn't I have the right to do what Angelina Jolie did?': Inside a breast surgery clinic in Paris
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (1/5).
